lines.text: Bel and Nebo crouch, their idols weigh down beasts and cattle, and the gods themselves go into captivity.
The LORD says He has carried Israel since birth, and when they turn gray He will bear them up.
People hire a goldsmith to make a god of gold, then carry it on their shoulders and set it in place.
The LORD says there is none like Him, and He summons a lion from the east for His purpose.
The LORD is bringing His righteousness near and will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with His splendor.
